$comment: Ranked press inventory. Machine-written by scripts/press-scan.mjs, human-correctable. Anything with "locked": true survives a rescan untouched — that is how you keep a hand-written verdict. See README.md for the scoring model and the attribution tiers. Every url here returned a live response when it was added; `http` records what it returned.
generatedBy: manual seed (verified by hand; scanner not yet keyed)

summary.note: No third-party article names GHXSTSHIP. Searches for the brand return only our own site. Everything below is coverage OF THE WORK, not of us — useful as proof the projects are real and notable, not as a citation that we delivered them. Read the attribution field before quoting anything.

polymarket-free-grocery-store.title: The Polymarket
polymarket-free-grocery-store.note: By far the most-covered entry, and the most careful to use. The activation itself drew national pickup, but a meaningful slice of it is politically framed or skeptical. Quote the service and the donation, not the crowd scenes.

items.why: National outlet, straight reporting on the opening. Best single link for 'this was real and it was big'.
Announcement piece; pairs with the opening story as a before/after.
Business-desk framing; useful when the audience is a brand-side buyer rather than a fan.
Local broadcast, service-piece tone. Has b-roll value.
Explainer format, culture audience.
Listing, not press. Confirms dates and location.
Explicitly frames the store as possibly-publicity-over-philanthropy. Logged so we know it exists and are not surprised by it. Do not cite.
Politically framed, leads on chaos and hardship. Logged for awareness only. Never cite.

patron-cristalino-becky-g.title: PATRÓN Cristalino x Becky G
patron-cristalino-becky-g.note: The cleanest inventory of the set: uniformly positive, image-rich, and all of it about the event itself. Best entry to build a case study around.

items.why: WWD is the authority for this audience and it is a photo gallery — the strongest single asset in the whole inventory.
On-the-night write-up with performance detail. Quotable.
Reaches the Latin-market audience the activation was built for.
Covers the room and the guest list.
Local LA pickup.

items.httpNote: bot-blocked to automated clients; loads in a browser
items.why: Local LA pickup with the full performer list.
About the Rainwater Project limited-edition Silver bottle, not the Cristalino launch night. Same partner, different moment — verify before using it as proof of this project.

salvage-city-supper-club.title: Salvage City Supper Club
salvage-city-supper-club.note: Thin on true press but strong on primary sources, and it is the one entry with a live case study to point the coverage at.

items.why: The only real editorial feature on the experience. Describes the show, not just the ticket.
The client's own page for the experience. Strongest available proof it is a sanctioned part of EDC.
"Returns to" framing is useful: it establishes the thing ran more than once.
The project's own site. Source of truth for menu, chef and format.
Guest reviews, unvetted and mixed by nature. Monitor, do not cite.

heineken-turn-4-nightclub.title: Heineken Turn 4 Nightclub
heineken-turn-4-nightclub.note: The trade coverage is the valuable part here — BizBash is read by exactly the people who hire this work.

items.why: The single most on-target link in the inventory: an event-production trade rounding up the activations at this exact race.
Establishes the weekend's profile. Does not name the Turn 4 club — context, not proof.

items.httpNote: WAF-blocked to automated clients; loads in a browser
items.why: Promoter's own wrap-up. Good for figures and official language.

red-bull-unforeseen-motel.title: Red Bull Unforeseen Motel
red-bull-unforeseen-motel.note: The press calls it Red Bull Unforeseen FULL MOON Motel. Worth deciding whether our card should match the name the coverage uses.

items.httpNote: bot-blocked to automated clients; loads in a browser
items.why: A full feature on the activation — build, curation and intent, not just a set time. Credits III Points' David Sinopoli and creative director Veronica Gessa; we are not named.
Set times only. Confirms the Red Bull Unforeseen slot existed on the 2024 bill.
Festival's own lineup page.

factory-town.title: Factory Town
factory-town.note: Plenty exists about the venue; none of it about who runs its site operations. Reference material for the venue's scale and history, not proof of our role.

items.why: History and ownership: the 1946 Dixie Bedding factory, operated by Link Miami Rebels alongside Club Space. Good for the seven-acre framing.
The venue's own site.
Venue profile.
Miami Music Week guide. Low authority; useful only for atmosphere.

l-acoustics-dj.title: L-Acoustics DJ
l-acoustics-dj.note: No coverage found tying an L-Acoustics install at III Points to a named integrator. If the install is public, an L-Acoustics case study or a trade placement in Mix / ProSoundWeb / Live Design is the realistic first placement.

black-coffee-race-track.title: Black Coffee at the Race Track
black-coffee-race-track.note: Nothing found. If this is a 2026 date that has not happened yet, re-run after it does.

fifa-world-cup-brazil-base-camp.title: FIFA World Cup Brazil Base Camp
fifa-world-cup-brazil-base-camp.note: Nothing found tying a New Jersey Brazil base camp to a named hospitality or operations partner. High-visibility subject — worth a standing alert rather than a monthly sweep.
